Definition: Jimnah, the name of two Israelites; also (with the article) of the posterity of one of them
BiblicalUsage: Jimnah is the name of two Israelites, and of the posterity of one of them. In Genesis 46:17, Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui. The fuller story is told on the Jimnah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jimnah matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
